'''CN-94''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] in service of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], found on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] around [[3643 BBY]].
